These mantises have grown to an unusual size, which makes their camouflage less effective in most environments. As such, they're usually found in areas where a blossom the size of an adult human could pass as normal, in the lushest rainforests, or in lands where rare medicinal herbs are cultivated. Tame giant orchid mantises can also be found protecting those rich enough to afford such decorative guards. **[Recall Knowledge - Animal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10)): DC 16 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 11 [Giant Orchid Mantis](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2777) **Source** [Tian Xia World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=223) pg. 292 **Perception** +6; [low-light vision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=69) **Languages** **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +8, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +7, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +10 **Str** +3 **Dex** +4 **Con** +3 **Int** -5 **Wis** +2 **Cha** -4 **Floral Camouflage** When Hiding, the giant orchid mantis is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) by any amount of leaves or petals, even if they aren't thick enough to make other creatures concealed.
 --- **AC** 18 **Fort** +9 **Ref** +10 **Will** +6 **HP** 30 --- **Speed** 40 feet, climb 20 feet, fly 20 feet **Melee** mandibles +11 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)), **Damage** 1d10+3 piercing **Melee** leg +11 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)), **Damage** 1d8+3 piercing **Barbed Limbs** The giant orchid mantis makes two leg Strikes. If it hits the same creature with both attacks, that creature is [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77) until the end of the mantis's next turn. **Sudden Strike** In the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted are [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to the orchid mantis.
name: Giant Orchid Mantis
